item.title: Trash & Recycling Add-On
item.creator: Octovon
item.description:
Organize your mess with the Trash & Recycling Add-On! Recycle your junk into useful items, incinerate or uncraft unwanted trash and cruise around in a garbage truck. Watch out for mischievous raccoons and automate cleanup with Trash Collector Golems.

+ Uncrafter, Incinerator, Stone Crusher & Recycling Bin Blocks
+ Raccoon pet & Golems
+ Drivable Garbage Truck
item.changelog: - Added "& Recycling" to title, description & guidebook to match marketing images

faqEntries.heading: What items go in each Recycling Bin?
faqEntries.content: Glass Bin takes glass items, Metal Bin takes ores/ingots/tools, Organic Bin takes food and plant items, and Paper Bin takes paper, books, and similar items.

faqEntries.heading: What happens if I try to recycle, uncraft, or crush a valuable or enchanted item?
faqEntries.content: These blocks will ask you to confirm before consuming it, so you don't lose something valuable by accident.

faqEntries.heading: Can I automate these blocks with hoppers?
faqEntries.content: Yes — Recycling Bins, the Incinerator, and the Stone Crusher can all be fed and emptied with hoppers.

faqEntries.heading: Why won't the Uncrafter give my item back?
faqEntries.content: Some items like planks, raw ores, and a few other base resources can't be uncrafted, to prevent item duplication. Damaged items also can't be uncrafted; they need to be at least half durability to be reversed.

faqEntries.heading: My Trash Collector Golem is holding the wrong item — how do I get it back?
faqEntries.content: Sneak and interact with the golem to retrieve whatever it's currently carrying.

howToEntries.heading: How do the Recycling Bins work?
howToEntries.content: Craft a Glass, Metal, Organic, or Paper Recycling Bin and place it down. Interact with a matching item in hand to feed it into the bin. Once it's full, it produces reward items and XP.

howToEntries.heading: How do I build a golem?
howToEntries.content: Golems are built from Trash Bags and Cardboard Boxes, and the shape you build changes what you get. Stack a Trash Bag directly on top of a Cardboard Box to create a Trash Collector Golem, which automatically picks up nearby items and delivers them to your recycling bins. Build the two blocks in a classic golem shape instead (Trash Bag as the head, Cardboard Boxes forming the body and arms) to create a Trash Golem, a combat guardian that fights off hostile mobs near your base.

howToEntries.heading: How do I use the Incinerator?
howToEntries.content: Craft and place the Incinerator, then interact with the top of the block to open its inventory and deposit unwanted items. Send it a redstone pulse to burn everything inside into Ash and a bit of XP.

howToEntries.heading: How do I use the Uncrafter?
howToEntries.content: Hold the item you want to break back down into materials, then interact with the Uncrafter. If the item can be reversed, it will consume it and give you back its original crafting ingredients.

howToEntries.heading: How do I use the Stone Crusher?
howToEntries.content: Hold a stone-type item or block and interact with the Stone Crusher to grind it into Stone Cobble.
